title: Article 13 — Laws inconsistent with fundamental rights

content.overview: Article 13 is the invalidating rule for Part III. Inconsistent pre-constitutional law is void to the extent of inconsistency. Abridging post-constitutional law is void to that extent.
content.study: Doctrines of severability, eclipse and waiver are read with this article. A constitutional amendment is not ordinary law under clause (2) after clause (4). Point to the law and the right said to be abridged.
